coverage_notes.source_review: CMS official listing unchanged. Twelve targeted searches returned stale or previously logged service losses, including Vista Medical Center East's trauma designation change, historical reopenings, and proposed Crozer-Chester services not yet effective; none demonstrated a new, qualified U.S./territory access change since last run. Guam Regional Medical City outpatient restoration occurred October 19–20 and was previously recognized. International events, speculative plans, aggregate/opinion reports, and ownership-only stories excluded.
coverage_notes.exclusions: Previously logged CMS notices; previously reported Vista trauma/anesthesia/dialysis service losses; non-U.S. cases; proposed reopening without operational confirmation; unrelated or historical examples; opinion/aggregate advocacy; unsupported social-media claims.
coverage_notes.limitations: Sunday local reporting and search-indexing delays may conceal very recent developments; this bounded 12-query sweep is not exhaustive and does not replace production.
coverage_notes.controls: No approval, publication, production changes, scheduling changes, or disablement.
